Name: Hollywood Undead Masks
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[heading][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]Hollywood Undead Masks [/font][/size][/color][/heading]
Bring the iconic masks of Hollywood Undead to Stardew Valley! This content pack for [b]Fashion Sense[/b] adds a collection of masks, a cap, a bandana, and sunglasses inspired by the band members. Whether you want to farm as Danny, cause chaos as J-Dog, or just wear Charlie Scene's signature look, this mod has you covered.

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]✨ Features[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Static Masks[/b] (4-directional, no animation):
[list]
[*]Danny[/*]
[*]Funny Man[/*]
[*]Deuce[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Animated Masks[/b] (5-frame animation on the front view):
[list]
[*]Johnny 3 Tears[/*]
[*]J-Dog[/*]
[*]Da Kurlzz[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Charlie Scene Set[/b] (mix and match):
[list]
[*][b]Cap[/b] (Hat category) – classic black cap.[/*]
[*][b]Bandana[/b] (Accessory category) – wears on the head.[/*]
[*][b]Sunglasses[/b] (Accessory category) – aviator style.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]All items are accessible through the [b]Hand Mirror[/b] (purchased from Pierre or selected at character creation). 

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]📋 Requirements[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API)[/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense[/b] (by PeacefulEnd)[/*]
[/list]Make sure both are installed and up to date before using this mod.

[color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🔧 Installation[/font][/size][/color]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Fashion Sense if you haven't already.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Place the Hollywood Undead Masks folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Buy the Hand Mirror from Pierre (or start a new game with it) and open the Fashion Sense menu to equip the items.[/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]📝 Notes[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Charlie Scene's Cap[/b] does [b]not[/b] hide the farmer's hair. For the best look, use short or tied-back hairstyles that don't have volume on top. The cap will sit naturally on your head, and the hair will show underneath.[/*]
[*][b]Bandana and Sunglasses[/b] are accessories, so you can wear them together with the cap or with any other hat from Fashion Sense or the base game.[/*]
[*]The [b]animated masks[/b] feature a subtle 5-frame animation on the front-facing view, giving them a unique, lively feel.[/*]
[/list][color=#00ffff][size=5][font=Arial Black]🎨 Credits[/font][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Original masks and designs[/b]: Hollywood Undead (inspiration only).[/*]
[*][b]Mod created by[/b]: [MGLXI][/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense framework[/b]: PeacefulEnd[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]: Pathoschild[/*]
[/list]This mod is a fan-made tribute. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hollywood Undead or their management.
